C1177.title: Instagram 2026 Data Scraping Incident: 17 Million Account Records Exposed via API Abuse
C1177.summary: Instagram experienced a data leak affecting 17 million user accounts, caused by data scraping and API abuse. Attackers exploited API endpoints to conduct large-scale scraping and harvest account information, highlighting gaps in API security protections.

references.title: Instagram denies breach amid claims of 17 million account data leak - BleepingComputer
There was no data breach, Instagram says - Help Net Security
